## Review checklist

- [ ] Commits reference the issue and contain only relevant changes.
- [ ] Behavior changes include meaningful success and failure tests at the affected boundaries, or this change has no executable behavior.
- [ ] Engineering boundaries and public documentation match the change.
- [ ] Validation results and remaining limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] Security and performance impacts are reviewed, with appropriate evidence and linked follow-ups.
